subject: words
title: Igh and y as long i
about: Two more ways to spell long i: igh in the middle (night, light) and y at the end of a short word (fly, sky). Neither is in the CKLA Grade 1 code (my, by and why are tricky words at school; both spellings come in Grade 2), so this is a step-ahead level for after Unit 7; NC RF.1.4.c (vowel teams for long vowel sounds).
tip: Three letters, one sound: have him tap igh as one dot and say the letter name i; at the end of a short word, y is a vowel that says i too.
